profile.headline: Software Engineer at Headway

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Headway is building a new mental healthcare system that everyone can access, making it easier for mental health providers to accept insurance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Binti builds software with the goal of helping every child have a family. 400,000 children are currently in foster care in the US and millions are in orphanages around the world. 30% of the US’s homeless population and 25% of prison inmates experienced foster care as youth. It’s clear that children who don’t have families don’t have a fair chance at life and Binti wants to change this. Binti is a mission-driven, technology company based in Oakland, California.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Clover Health is a data-driven health insurance startup driving to improve the overall state of healthcare in America.

positions.title: Implementation Engineer II
positions.description: Opower combines a cloud-based platform, big data, and behavioral science to help utilities around the world reduce energy consumption and improve their relationship with their customers. This helps consumers lower their energy use and costs, and significantly reduces carbon emissions.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
Completed the highly selective Hackbright Academy Fellowship, a 10-week program for women who graduate to be full-stack engineers.

Developed MonkeyMind, a web application that provides visual and auditory feedback on brainwave activity using Neurosky’s EEG headset, Mindwave.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Documented the changing dynamics of low-income communities and families in the largest metropolitan areas of the US through data analysis and map visualizations. 

Co-authored numerous Brookings Institution research papers and blogs. Contributed to the data analysis and visual presentation in The Brookings Institution's 2014 book, "Confronting Suburban Poverty in America," including all maps.

positions.title: Women's Mentoring Network Steering Committee Member
positions.description: Developed professional development, mentoring, social, and volunteer programming for women working at The Brookings Institution.

positions.title: Volunteer Client Coordinator
positions.description: Assisted with client intake to ensure clients had all the documents they need to file and take advantage of relevant tax credits, including the Earned Income Tax Credit and Child Tax Credit.

positions.title: Digital Humanities Research Assistant
positions.description:
Geo-referenced historical aerial images of Soweto, South Africa to track urban development from late 1930s though 1990.

Digitized and coded historical architecture and housing plans for Soweto townships.

positions.title: Co-chair and Co-Founder of Middlebury College DREAM
positions.description:
Founded college’s chapter of mentoring organization that works with children living in affordable housing communities.

Grew program from informal campus group of 2-3 to established organization of 20+ .

Organized a fundraiser in June 2013 that raised over $2,000 to start DREAM in Washington, DC.

positions.title: Visualization Intern with Population Distribution Branch
positions.description: Developed charts, graphs, and maps for the publication of The Census Bureau's first comprehensive atlas of historical Census data.

educations.schoolName: School for International Training, Ireland: Transformation of Social and Political Conflict

honors.title: Bonnie McCardell Public Service Award
honors.description: The Bonnie McCardell Public Service Award is awarded to a student or students for excellence in outreach in literacy, youth and family services, or the special needs of at-risk young people.

publications.title: Part of the Solution: Pre-Baccalaureate Healthcare Workers in a Time of Health System Change
EITC Expansion Would Strengthen Credit for Childless Workers

organizations.name: 4K for Cancer
organizations.description: Biked across the country  (Baltimore to Portland) with 25 other students during the summer of 2011 in support of the fight against cancer with the organization, 4K for Cancer (www.4kforcancer.org). Individually raised over $17,000 as part of this journey. As an organization, we raised nearly $0.5 million!
